round_history_note: ROUND 1: REJECTED (F-001 act_id collision Clipart/Vector in APIOP-001..005 + resurrected excluded evidence; F-002 consequence in KB-003/004/005/007). ROUND 2: REJECTED (F-001/F-002 confirmed fixed correctly, but F-003 found: same collision pattern un-audited in APIOP-006..016 / 13 KB items / CONF-003 / 3 profiles / 3 checklists). ROUND 3: REJECTED (full C0-C6 re-audit confirmed F-003's fix fully correct everywhere, but surfaced 2 NEW findings: F-004 — 3 official acts with real captured mutation evidence for TASK-3 (the run's highest-priority task) were never mapped to any operation across 3 rounds, despite api-explorer's own coverage claim being factually wrong; F-005 — CONF-003.sides[1] mischaracterized categories 6012/6013/6014 as 'category MỚI', self-contradicting the correctly-fixed KB-011 in the same file, and propagating into checklist CHK-002 vs CHK-001). Round 3's rework was narrowly scoped to the item-management branch + a targeted addition to action-api-map.json, and its own allowed_next_steps[3] explicitly instructed round 4 to verify exactly 4 points ((a) the 3 newly-added acts' correctness, (b) CONF-003 no longer contradicting KB-011, (c) CHK-001/CHK-002 no longer contradicting each other with no oracle upgrade, (d) no regression via full-repo redaction re-scan + 31-act reconciliation script) without requiring a full from-scratch re-read of the untouched crud/bulk-upload/route-entity-clarification branches. ROUND 4 (this verdict): all 4 points independently verified PASS. F-004 and F-005 are both CLOSED. No regression found: full-repo redaction re-scan (226 files, 130 text-bearing) is clean; the 31-act reconciliation script independently confirms action-api-map.json's own corrected act_coverage.acts_with_at_least_one_operation=27 (27 operation-referenced + 1 via background_traffic + 3 zero-network-by-design = 31, matching total_acts_upstream exactly); filesystem mtimes and targeted grep for 'ROUND 4' markers confirm the 3 untouched profiles/checklists and APIOP-001..006/009..016 were not touched. Decision: APPROVED_WITH_CONDITIONS, publish_allowed=true — the conditions are pre-existing, non-blocking, and already-documented items (portal-level C1 conditions from round1-3, the CL-10 partial-evidence gap, and CONF-003/STALE-001 remaining UNRESOLVED pending an orchestrator policy decision on re-testing 6008/6009/6010 directly), none of which are new findings from this round and none of which represent provenance loss, assumption leakage, unsafe evidence, or broken version lineage.
